articles.title: Joe Hickey Joins North Wales Crusaders on Loan
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Hornets half-back Joe Hickey has been loaned to North Wales Crusaders until the end of the season to gain more playing time.
articles.content_html:
A half-back has joined North Wales Crusaders on loan from Rochdale Hornets until the end of the season. Joe Hickey, who joined the Hornets in October last year, has made six appearances for the club this season.

Hickey has played twice in the Betfred Challenge Cup, once in the 1895 Cup, and three times in the Championship. His last match for the Hornets was in May against Goole Vikings.

The club has sanctioned the loan to provide Hickey with further game time to support his development, while retaining the option to recall him during the loan period. Everyone at the club wishes him well with the move.

For further information, fans can contact the Hornets at Spotland Stadium, Sandy Lane, Rochdale, OL11 5DR, or by telephone at 01706 648 004.
